name: Nyx Gloomweaver
equipment: Arcane focus (a black crystal pendant that whispers in the dark)
A scroll case full of notes on aberrant entities
features: Infernal Legacy (Thaumaturgy cantrip; Hellish Rebuke 1/day as 2nd-level spell at 3rd level; CHA-based)
Otherworldly Patron: The Great Old One
Awakened Mind (telepathic communication with any creature within 30 ft that understands a language)
Pact Magic (2 spell slots, regain on short rest, all spells cast at 2nd level)
Pact Boon: Pact of the Tome (Book of Shadows with 3 additional cantrips from any class list)
Eldritch Invocations: Agonizing Blast (add CHA mod to Eldritch Blast damage), Devil's Sight (see in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 ft)
Discovery (Hermit feature: discovered a truth about the entities that dwell in the Far Realm)

cantrips: Spare the Dying (Pact of the Tome)

personality.traits: I often stare into empty space, listening to whispers only I can hear. I speak in metaphors and riddles without meaning to — the influence of my patron bleeds into my speech patterns.
personality.ideals: Knowledge. Understanding the entities beyond the veil is the only way to protect the world from them — or to survive when they inevitably arrive.
personality.bonds: The whispers from the Far Realm led me to the Underdark. Something down here is connected to my patron, and I must understand what — before it understands me.
personality.flaws: I am drawn to forbidden knowledge like a moth to flame, and I sometimes forget that not all secrets should be uncovered. My patron's influence makes me increasingly detached from normal human concerns.

appearance: A slender tiefling woman of 5'8" with ashen-purple skin and hair like black smoke that seems to drift slightly even without wind. Her horns are smooth and swept back, almost elegant, and her eyes are solid black — a mark of her patron's influence rather than her tiefling heritage. She wears simple, dark clothing beneath leather armor, and her black crystal pendant pulses with a faint, rhythmic light like a heartbeat. When she speaks, there is a barely perceptible echo to her voice, as if something is speaking alongside her.
backstory: Nyx was a scholar of the arcane at the University of Silverymoon until a late-night research session breached the wrong barrier. A fragment of awareness from a Great Old One — an entity that exists between dimensions — touched her mind, and nothing was the same after. The visions came nightly: alien geometries, stars with wrong colors, and always the whispers, guiding her toward understanding. The university expelled her when her behavior became too erratic, and she retreated to a hermitage in the mountains where she spent two years transcribing the whispers and trying to understand her patron's nature. The whispers led her to the Underdark — something down here resonates with her patron's frequency, and the psychic environment of the deep places makes the whispers clearer. She does not know if her patron is guiding her to salvation or destruction, but she cannot stop seeking the answer.
